firstAccount.title: No account yet?
firstAccount.body: This skeleton folds registration into the sign-in flow and ships neither SMS nor social sign-in, so a fresh deployment has no account to sign in with. Write the first one with the server's seed command, then sign in here (see starters/demo/AGENTS.md).

home.heading: Get started
home.intro: This skeleton ships no business domain of its own. These are the platform capabilities that already work -- take a look around before you grow your own.
home.grow: Your product's own pages land under src/pages and are named in one place, the route table in src/routes.tsx, which feeds both the navigation and the rendered view.
